description: The core battle skill system. Skills define targeting, energy management, effect chains, and buff application. The execution pipeline flows: Skill -> SkillEffect (Skilleffcet) -> BuffGroup -> individual Buff instances. Special buffs (Specil_buff) handle state-based CC and status effects.

ConfigSkill.description: Master skill definition table. Each skill has targeting rules, effect chains, energy costs, and buff groups.

type.description: Skill type classification (maps to SkillType enum: 1=USE, 2=PASSIVE_ADD, 3=PASSIVE_EFFECT, 4=PARTNER_SKILL, 5=FLY_SKILL)

chapter_type.description: Chapter/mode restrictions where this skill is available

if_chapter_type.description: Chapter filter mode: 0=inclusion (only active in listed chapters), non-0=exclusion (active everywhere except listed)

autoDis.description: Auto-targeting distance; XOR-encoded. If > 0, skill auto-targets enemies within this range

buffGroup.description: Buff groups applied by this skill. Each entry: [groupIndex, buffId, duration, buffGroupType]. Cross-references ConfigBuff.

addSkill.description: Additional skills triggered by this skill

targetType.description: Target selection rules: [filterType, count, selectFilter]. filterType maps to TargetFilter enum

skillEffect2.description: Secondary skill effect IDs (used by angel passive enhancement)

skillPar.description: Skill parameters; indexed by buffGroup entries to select damage coefficient from Skill_level.skillCoefficient

immediate_time.description: Whether skill triggers immediately (0=no, >0=delay in ms)

ConfigSkill_level.description: Per-level scaling data for skills. Controls damage coefficients, stat effects, and upgrade costs.

skillCoefficient.description: Damage coefficients per hit. Indexed by ConfigSkill.skillPar to determine buff damage. Values are /10000 fixed-point.

ConfigSkill_pos.description: Skill slot/position definitions with unlock conditions.

ConfigSkilleffcet.note: Table name has a typo: 'effcet' instead of 'effect'
ConfigSkilleffcet.description: Skill effect definitions. Each effect can target enemies/allies, apply buffs, chain into further effects, and spawn visual projectiles.

trapId.description: Trap/summon IDs spawned by this effect

targetType.description: Target selection: [filterType, selfOrEnemy]. If [x,1], targets self/caster.

execute.description: Execution timing: [duration, totalTime]. Controls how long the effect persists.

buffGroup.description: Buff groups applied on hit. Each: [groupIndex, buffId, duration, buffGroupType]

randomType.description: Random selection mode for buffs (0=all, 1=random pick)

skillEffect.description: Chained skill effect IDs; enables multi-stage effects

effctId.description: Visual effect asset ID (typo preserved from source)

skillPar.description: Parameter indices for damage coefficient lookup

ConfigBuff.description: Individual buff definitions. Each buff has a type, group, stacking rules, and up to 5 parameters that control its behavior.

group.description: BuffGroupType enum value; determines how the buff is processed in combat

effect.description: Visual effect played on the buffed unit

mutex.description: Mutex group; buffs in the same mutex group overwrite each other

param1.description: Generic parameter 1 (meaning depends on group type)

ConfigSpecil_buff.note: Table name has a typo: 'Specil' instead of 'Special'
ConfigSpecil_buff.description: Special buffs for crowd-control and state effects (stun, silence, etc.).

state_icon.description: Status icon displayed on affected unit

EffectTriggerType.description: Determines when a passive skill effect triggers during combat.

HIT.description: Triggers when the unit is hit

USE_SKILL.description: Triggers when any skill is used

HP_Hurt.description: Triggers when HP damage is taken

DIZZ.description: Triggers when a stun/dizz is inflicted

NORMAL_DOUBLE_ATTACK.description: Triggers on normal + double attack combined

BuffGroupType.description: Classifies how a buff is processed by the combat engine. Each type has its own handler in BuffCtr.

USE_SKILL_NORMAL_ADD.description: Adds effect when using skill then normal attack

DESTROY_WHEN_NORMAL_AFTER.description: Buff destroyed after next normal attack

AddBuffTrigger.description: Triggers when a buff is added

TOTAL_DAMAGE_TRIGGER.description: Triggers based on total damage dealt

FRAGILE_EFFECT.description: Fragile/vulnerability debuff; calDamage adds bonus damage

DESTROY_WHEN_SKILL_AFTER.description: Buff destroyed after next skill use

SKILL_BUFFTIME_ADD.description: Extends buff duration for specific skills

GIANT_SLAYER.description: Bonus damage based on target max HP (onCalHpDamage)

EXTRA_DAMAGE.description: Extra damage modifier (calDamage with skillId filter)

DAMAGE_TRIGGER.description: Triggers effect based on damage dealt

HealthType.description: All damage and healing event types in combat.

UnityType.description: Unit type classification for all battle entities.

executionFlow.description: Skill execution pipeline as observed in SkillHandleNormal.ts, SkillHandleEffect.ts, and SkillHandleBase.ts
executionFlow.setPlayerSkill_code: Sorts active_skill by pos_id, adds each skill with addSkill(skillId, skillLv), sets useDelay from delay_time/1000
normalAttackFlow: 1. beginRun(): Play attack animation, trigger STATE_TRIGER buffs with Normal_Act
2. checkHit(): Determine hit type (Miss=0, Normal=1, Crit=2) using accuracy/evasion
4. normalHurt() or normalDoubleHurt(): Calculate damage using base formula
5. Apply NORMAL_ACT_NUM_TRIGGER buffs (bonus damage after N attacks)
7. Apply boss_dam multiplier if target is Boss type
8. Apply FRAGILE_EFFECT debuffs on target (calDamage adds % bonus)
9. Apply EXTRA_DAMAGE buffs on caster (calDamage with skill ID filter)
10. Apply GIANT_SLAYER buffs (onCalHpDamage based on target HP)
11. healthTarget(): Apply final damage, trigger death checks
12. HP steal: normailHpsteal() for life steal, trigger HP_Heal effects
13. Stun check: checkDizz() -> apply vertigo_times * (1 - vertigo_res)
14. Trigger passive skill effects: NORMAL_ATTACK, CRIT_ATTACK, ALL_ATTACK, HP_Hurt
skillEffectFlow: 1. SkillHandleEffect.beginRun(): Increment hurtNumCount, remove DESTROY_WHEN_SKILL_AFTER buffs
2. Trigger USE_SKILL and ALL_ATTACK passive effects (with skill ID filtering via param5)
5. SkillHandleBase.checkBuff(): Apply buff groups from ConfigSkilleffcet.buffGroup
- Roll buffRate probability for each group
- Look up damage coefficient from skillCoefficient via skillPar index
- Apply buff with duration from execute field
6. Chain to nested skillEffect IDs if present
buffApplication: 3. Check mutex group -- if same mutex exists, overwrite
5. Create buff instance with group-specific handler (BuffGroupType)
6. Handler processes param1-param5 based on group type
